subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Should this broad feature issue remain as an umbrella tracker, be split into focused follow-ups, or be closed in favor of existing narrower SecretRef/update/audit items?
rationale: Current main partially implements the request, but the remaining pieces cross update UX, systemd credential deployment, and audit semantics; automation cannot choose the product boundary or security posture safely.

options.title: Split into focused follow-ups
options.body: Create or canonicalize separate items for systemd SecretRef deployment guidance, update config-diff reporting, and unified audit semantics, then close or repurpose this umbrella once links are recorded.

options.title: Keep as umbrella tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as a maintainer-owned coordination item, accepting that it is not a safe one-PR repair target.

options.title: Close as mostly covered
options.body: Close this issue after linking existing narrower issues and the merged audit work, if maintainers decide the remaining ideas should not be tracked from this umbrella.

recommendation.title: Split into focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Create or canonicalize separate items for systemd SecretRef deployment guidance, update config-diff reporting, and unified audit semantics, then close or repurpose this umbrella once links are recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: The current remaining direction crosses audit product semantics and maintainer-level security/setup boundaries, and steipete authored the merged audit foundation now partially satisfying the request.
